articles.summary: Research indicates that the next phase of enterprise AI adoption will be defined by operational outcomes. As tariff exposure, demand volatility and margin pressure continue to intensify, supply chain leaders are increasingly expected to improve service reliability, strengthen resilience, improve working capital management and absorb disruption without proportional increases in resources.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Introduces AI World Class Supply Chain Benchmarks

articles.summary: Research reveals that a 75% performance gap is emerging between organizations that redesign end-to-end processes around AI and those that simply automate existing processes. According to The Hackett Group’s analysis, AI World Class organizations achieve significant advantages by simplifying technology environments, reimagining work and directing AI investments to the highest-value opportunities across the enterprise.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Establishes AI World Class Information Technology Benchmarks

articles.summary: A record $1.94 trillion in working capital is tied up across North America's largest companies. Yet many organizations are reporting strong growth, profitability and cash flow. What's the disconnect? Our 2026 North America Working Capital Survey points to growing inefficiencies in how revenue is converted into cash, with receivables emerging as the largest and fastest-growing source of working capital opportunity.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Finds Record $1.94 Trillion Working Capital Opportunity Among North America’s Largest Companies
